title: Can the gantry on a machine-bed pit furnace also lift workpieces?
summary: Suneng's 2019 pit furnace proposal for machine-tool bed castings uses a fixed furnace body and movable lid, with a travelling gantry offered as an option. The structural description assigns the gantry to lifting and moving the lid. Its stated load figures do not establish workpiece-handling capacity. Review lid movement, workpiece lifting and pit-opening clearances separately when selecting site lifting equipment.
